WE PROVIDE HIGH-QUALITY, LOCAL, NATURAL BEEF.

We acquired almost 300 acres in Putnam County, GA in 2013. Since then, we have been growing our herd and restoring our land through the use of rotational grazing and regenerative agriculture. Our cattle live a natural life on beautiful pastures, and are 100% grass-fed. We believe this slow and natural way of raising cattle produces happier animals, better land management, and ultimately, higher quality beef. We are now proud to offer our top quality beef at local markets and restaurants.

OUR PRODUCTS
SUSTAINABILITY

We have always had a great appreciation for conservation and land preservation. So, when we bought this land we were excited to restore our farm and preserve it for future generations. As our passion for the land grew, we realized an opportunity to raise grass-fed, natural cattle on our pastures. Through regenerative agriculture we are able to both improve our land and provide high-quality food to our community.

OUR BEEF

Our beef is dry aged for 14 days. The beef is processed at a USDA or Georgia State inspected facility and is provided in vacuum sealed packaging. Our herd are a mix of South Poll, Angus, Herford, and Brangus to produce hybrid vigor. Our calves are born and spend their entire life on our pastures, with rotational grazing and supplemented in the winter with hay we produce on the farm. Learn more!

Return Policy: We take great pride in our beef and guaranteed it to be delivered freshly frozen, vacuum sealed and in excellent condition. Our goal is to deliver high quality meat to your order specifications. Due to food safety regulations beef can not be returned for a refund once it has been delivered.

WHOLE, HALF & QUARTERS

We also provide our beef in bulk as ¼, ½, or a whole cow. We price this product at $6.00/ lb hanging weight. The actual meat delivered after 14 days of dry aging and butchering is about 60-70% of the hanging weight. As a rough estimate, the hanging weight of a whole cow is 500 lbs. This price includes all processing fees for pick up at the farm.

ABOUT

We acquired almost 300 acres in Putnam County, GA in 2013. With a great appreciation for conservation and land preservation, we planned to restore our farm and preserve it for future generations. As our passion for the land grew, we realized an opportunity to raise grass-fed, natural cattle on our pastures. We are now proud to offer our top quality beef at local markets and restaurants.

THE FARM

In March 2013, Tom and Alex Pearson purchased 300 acres in Putnam County: the Dairy Capital of Georgia. The farm had been owned and run as a dairy farm until the 1980's, when it was sold in two parcels to friends who used the land for hunting and fishing—maintaining the fields for hay production. In 2003, it went into an Estate and was minimally maintained until 10 years later when the Pearsons purchased the majority of the two parcels consisting of approximately 70% pasture and 30% woods. Conservation, restoration and good stewardship of the land was the priority.

Perry Dykes, a long-time friend, suggested raising beef cattle on the land. With his expertise, enthusiasm and guidance we grew the herd to over 140 cows and calves. Sadly Perry passed away unexpectedly in September 2021. As we grieved the loss of our good friend and partner, a close friend of Perry’s stepped in to help. Austin Nix has an agricultural degree from Mississippi State University and works locally in the management of an egg production facility but his real passion is raising cattle. We are grateful that Austin now brings his expertise to help us manage and improve our farm.

Alex and Tom

THE BEEF

Our beef is hormone, antibiotic and steroid-free. They are 100% pasture-raised on herbicide-free grass using rotational grazing to maximize the forage and health of the land. The cattle are born, raised and spend their entire life on these pastures. We invite you to come out to our farm and see how our animals are raised.
